name: Glucose Tolerance Test
overview: Glucose Tolerance Test is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include the glucose tolerance test is a medical test in which glucose is given and blood samples taken afterward to determine how quickly it is cleared from the blood; the test is usually used to test for diabetes, insulin resistance, impaired beta cell function, and sometimes reactive hypoglycemia and acromegaly, or rarer disorders of carbohydrate metabolism; in the most commonly performed version of the test, an oral glucose tolerance test (ogtt), a standard dose of glucose is ingested by mouth and blood levels are checked two hours later. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
